subsections.title: Alternative GARCH bases
subsections.content: E-GARCH (Nelson 1991) and APARCH (Ding-Granger-Engle 1993) re-estimation; news-impact-curve comparison

subsections.title: Endogeneity / IV diagnostics
subsections.content: Granger VIX->BTC-RV (expected sig) vs BTC-RV->VIX (expected NS); AR(p) residual IV approach

subsections.title: Mechanism interpretation
subsections.content: Three non-mutually-exclusive channels: flight-to-quality, leverage-cycle (Geanakoplos 2010), sentiment-correlation

subsections.title: Relation to K1214 companion
subsections.content: K1214 BTC GAS-t negative result (within-BTC model family) vs Paper 10 positive cross-market transmission — complementary not conflicting; orthogonal research questions

subsections.title: Contribution vs existing literature
subsections.content: Bouri 2020 (correlation->GARCH-X variance-domain); Corbet 2018 (symmetric->asymmetric Granger+QR); Matkovskyy 2019 (receiver->bidirectional with honest OOS null)

subsections.title: Limitations
subsections.content: Single-crypto BTC, US-centric VIX proxy, daily frequency, 2015-02 start (pre-2015 microstructure noise)
